Property Update

Update on 18 Quarry Ridge Ct ( https://lofty.ai/property_deal/18-Quarry-Ridge-Ct_Fairview-IA-52001 )

The property manager has shared the following update:

Property Update (02/01/2026):

-This is Avery with Example Property Group. We are now able to send emails directly to owners through the PM portal on Lofty. Important updates should be more timely now that we can send the emails ourselves. However, the property channel on Discord is quicker, as we are both active there and able to answer any individual questions directly.
-The Dropbox is now updated with invoices and photos of the work done on the property since Example Property Group has taken over.
-Moving forward, the most up-to-date information will be uploaded to the Dropbox for this property monthly, which you can view https://www.dropbox.com/sh/example0000000/AAExampleFolderToken?dl=0
-If you are wondering why a property has not had an update in a while, chances are the tenant is paying and no major expenses have occurred, so be sure to check the Dropbox.
-The tenant in this property is current on rents through January.
-On 1/13, the tenant reported some maintenance requests, which were completed 1/16. The lock on the mailbox needed to be replaced, a hinge on the closet door needed repaired, and a loose baseboard in the hallway needed reattached.
-The tenant also reported that the water heater's pilot light assembly is failing intermittently, but I could not source a replacement part for this unit as it is an older model no longer supported by the manufacturer. Owners might want to consider replacing the water heater in the near future to ensure reliable hot water for the tenant. I would recommend that owners consider putting out a governance vote to determine a budget for a new one if they'd like to do that.
